title.zh: Tsrs: A Port of TypeScript to Rust
title.en: Tsrs: A Port of TypeScript to Rust

current_state.zh: Cloudflare details tsrs, a Rust port of the TypeScript compiler that uses arena-based memory management and runs in a WASM-only sandbox while outperforming the reference tsc/Go implementation.
current_state.en: Cloudflare details tsrs, a Rust port of the TypeScript compiler that uses arena-based memory management and runs in a WASM-only sandbox while outperforming the reference tsc/Go implementation.
